name: ProCardio
label: Software · Data and computer vision
text: An internship case study for a multi-tenant cardiology workflow, structured reporting, automation, and reviewed image-analysis suggestions.
detail: The public case study documents authenticated, hospital-scoped workflows, reporting automation, an OCR and retrieval-assisted document path, and reviewable computer-vision suggestions. The private source code, datasets, and weights remain restricted.

name: My Health Friend
label: Machine learning · Data pipeline
alt: My Health Friend machine-learning prediction screen
text: A Flask learning application with participant-aware data preparation, activity prediction, evaluation reports, and a separate contextual-bandit simulation.
detail: The repository implements dataset checks, participant-separated splits, preprocessing fitted on training data, Ridge and Random Forest comparisons, ROC/PR/calibration figures, and a bounded simulation benchmark. It is an educational prototype, not a clinical tool.

name: MedRec CareFlow
label: Full-stack · ML workflow
text: A Flask workflow demo for patient check-ins and clinician review, with field encryption, role controls, a reproducible ML fixture, and automated delivery checks.
detail: The code includes authentication, role-aware routes, CSRF and rate-limit protection, encrypted fields, report generation, a Logistic Regression baseline, tests, GitHub Actions, and a GHCR container build workflow.

name: HayatCare
label: AI · Computer vision
text: A care-companion prototype combining computer vision, an LLM-backed information assistant, local persistence, adaptive activities, reminders, and phone-motion handling.
detail: The public code includes optional YOLOv8 object detection through an image-upload flow, Gemini API calls with a constrained prompt, Flask routes, SQLite storage, scheduled reminder logic, and research-model adapters. It explicitly labels its health features as demonstrations rather than clinical tools.
